completion:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2. Select the result of the failed test for the month.  This result will be a sample from the municipal water authority.
3. Select the reason for the failure.  
4. Confirm the result and explanation was provided in the public notices discussed below.
5. Type in the time-frame from the date of the failure to the posting of the public notice for each of the forms of notice.
